title: 旧审计证据整理
scope: 逐报告关联精确函数/分支及版本，处理历史remaining的已解决/重复/仍开放状态。
source: primary reviewed matrix bootstrap; not exhaustive defect inventory

title: 依赖闭包
scope: 解析调用接收者、继承和动态目标，补充卡牌隐式依赖的战斗、事件与原生默认规则。
source: primary reviewed matrix bootstrap; not exhaustive defect inventory

title: 攻击其他模式
scope: 继续核对ChangeAttack模式6..255、局部默认状态和账本分支。
source: primary reviewed matrix bootstrap; not exhaustive defect inventory

title: 原生边界
scope: qqq输出、空上下文、对象生命周期、容器顺序和回调重入。
source: primary reviewed matrix bootstrap; not exhaustive defect inventory

title: 生成边界
scope: 相邻缺来源/无效控制方/默认位置；共享满位置/overrideCardID及完整分配通知。
source: primary reviewed matrix bootstrap; not exhaustive defect inventory

title: 版本关联
scope: 保留当前EXE与资产版本指纹和失效状态；按用户工作安排逐步补齐，不将旧卡表当作当前权威。
source: primary reviewed matrix bootstrap; not exhaustive defect inventory

title: 逐卡闭合与准入
scope: 依赖闭合后执行逐卡全部路径及联动验证，建立独立完整认证准入记录。
source: primary reviewed matrix bootstrap; not exhaustive defect inventory
